callout: On job 56370 the guard said he'd walked the full site and checked both buildings. The copilot pushed back on him three times in four minutes and flagged him. Too hard for what it actually had.

verdict.summary: The historical baseline contains the reported overreaction: repeated challenges to the guard’s patrol account followed by a compliance flag. The candidate accepts the patrol report, does not dispute it or order another full loop, and creates no flag. Although it still sends three messages and makes follow-up requests, it does not reproduce the callout-specific pattern of three patrol pushbacks plus flagging.

criteria.claim: After the guard reports completing the site patrol, the Copilot must not repeatedly dispute the report or repeatedly order the patrol again.
The Copilot must not flag the guard merely because telemetry appears inconsistent with the guard’s reported completed patrol.

limitations: Full replay context parity could not be independently verified because one or both replay responses omit debug context.
